text: web: tests time out under the parallel gate's load (vitest 5 s)

Again on 2026-11-01 (gate for T-376): RedeemPage 'redeems the token of an invite link pasted inside a whole message' at 5051 ms, alone; passed on the rerun. That is 3 of 7 gate runs today with a web timeout.

Cause found: all three failing runs on 2026-11-01 overlapped with a Gradle/Xcode job on the macOS guest, which shares the 12-core host with the gate (the maintainer saw it swap). Rule recorded. Hardening kept: the gate passes --testTimeout=15000 to vitest in both modes; the 5 s default stays for a developer's own vitest runs.
